title: Oliver is the best!
text:
LOVED our tour guide Oliver! The best!!
Just wish the towers was part of it; it was too much extra to go up. 
The museum (part of the fee) was EXCEPTIONAL!
Booking tickets was very hard if not done in advance but so happy we snagged the last two.
author: laureni322

title: Great experience.
text: We enjoyed our tour. Roger was very informative. Tour started on time and was a perfect size group. Roger answered questions and was very pleasant.
author: bondgirlone
